question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank 3
solution:
The correct answer is option no.(1) i.e. **'Development'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's take a look at the phrase: An expert (the teacher) knows more than they do about their own child's——(3).
 
• **Let's take a look at the options:**
 
 
• **Development-** The process of changing situation into a new result.
 
 
• **Example:- **I don't think there have been any new** developments **since yesterday.
 
 
 
• **Consistence-** Marked by harmony,regularity,or steady continuity.
 
 
• **Example:-** His performance has lacked **consistence** over the last year.
 
 
 
• **Submission- **The action of accepting or yielding to a superior force or to the will authority of another person.
 
 
• **Example-** I'm preparing the results of my study for** submission** to a medical journal.
 
 
 
• **Maniacs- **A person exhibiting extremely wild or violent behaviour.
 
 
• **Example- **Some **maniacs **were running down the street waving a massive bar.
 
 
 
 
 
• We have to use the most appropriate word for the given blank.
 
• An expert or teacher always develops the child.So,the hint goes to the word** Development.**
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word for the given blank is** Development.**
 
• The complete phrase is:*** An expert(the teacher) knows more than they do about their own child's development.__***

Thus, the correct answer is option no.**(1)**
